category_title: Preschoolers non-compliant with classroom maintenance routines like toy cleanup and garbage disposal
minimal_context: The student is playing with Lego and other toys in the classroom during play time and is asked to put the toys away.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Play time is over. It is time to start putting the toys away.

STUDENT: (Ignores the instruction) Look, I am making a tunnel with Lego!

TUTOR: You need to stop playing and clean up.

STUDENT: (Grabs other objects without permission) I want to play with these! (Messes the girls' houses up)

TUTOR: Please come back here and put the toys in the bin.

STUDENT: (Starts running around the classroom, making a lot of noise and whining) No! I don't want to!

options.A: Inform the student that they will not be allowed to participate in play time the next day.
options.B: Provide explicit visual or written scripts to enable the student to initiate an interaction (e.g., "Let's clean up together.").
options.C: Provide a detailed instruction of each specific element involved in putting the toys away.
options.D: Give the student a hug and tell them they are a lovely person who will soon play with friends.
